meta.description: Portfolio of Al Seny Diallo, Full-Stack software engineer based in Dakar: React, Next.js, NestJS, Node.js, PostgreSQL.

hero.tagline: I design and build robust web applications — NestJS APIs, React interfaces — with a strong focus on quality and maintainability.

paragraphs: Full-Stack developer with 4+ years of experience, I design, build and integrate REST APIs with NestJS, Node.js and PostgreSQL, and modern interfaces with React and Next.js.
At Quadra West Africa, I led the migration of KOOB's core backend — a SaaS travel booking platform — from Ruby on Rails to NestJS, and integrated partner APIs such as STAAH and Koedia.
I care deeply about code quality — Clean Architecture, DDD, CQRS, testing, Docker — and I enjoy sharing knowledge: I facilitate Scrum ceremonies and mentor interns and new developers.

koob.title: KOOB
koob.description: SaaS travel re-intermediation platform connecting travel producers, tour operators and agencies for instant booking. Migrated the backend from Ruby on Rails to NestJS and integrated the STAAH and Koedia APIs.
